notes.key_messages:
Some candidates are still losing marks for not giving answers to 3 significant figures and also due to
premature approximating. Candidates should be reminded that if an answer is required to 3 significant
figures then their working should be performed to at least 4 significant figures.
Candidates should always refer to the formula booklet if in doubt about a formula.
